memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "And Isaac dug again the wells of water which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them up after the death of Abraham. He called them by the names which his father had called them." (Genesis 26:18)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text: On our path of faith, the prayer life and divine presence experienced by our forefather Abraham and the servants who faithfully followed him are our primordial spiritual roots. However, the "soil" of worldly cares, daily compromises, and the enemy's strategies sometimes completely covers up those living springs. Just as Isaac dug again the wells of his father Abraham that were filled by the Philistines, it is necessary for us to restore our spiritual heritage and the ancient paths of our forebears with tears and faith. Rather than relying on modern, superficial, and flawed alternatives, returning to the profound truths of God's Word is the healthy beginning of true revival. When we remove the barriers and make the prayer experiences, holy lives, and burdens for souls of our early predecessors our very own, the Lord will fill our lives with even more abundant and expansive blessings.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: Seeking and returning to the ancient paths is not moving backward; rather, it is receiving renewed strength from God's eternal springs of life."

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Loving Father, grant us the grace to rediscover the springs of a prayer-filled life and fellowship with You that the enemy has covered up in our spiritual journey. Cleanse our hearts from the dirt and weariness of this world, and let the living river of Your Holy Spirit flow unhindered within us. In the name of Jesus Christ, we pray, good Father. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Are you worried that your spiritual life has become dry? Do not be discouraged. Today, the Lord is calling you back to the ancient paths and expansive blessings. Act in faith to remove those barriers; He will surely fill you with His grace.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: Classic, mature writings that nurture spiritual insight.
